midi.isAvailable.description: Checks whether MIDI works on this computer. Use midi.status to see why when it does not.
midi.isAvailable.returns: true when MIDI works here, otherwise false.

midi.status.description: Tells you how MIDI is working in Cuebot right now.
midi.status.returns: backend (the MIDI library in use), available (true/false), reason (why not, when unavailable), state and message (a status line).

midi.ports.description: Looks for MIDI ports on your computer right now, like a plugged-in keyboard or a virtual MIDI cable.

parameters.direction: Optional. "in" for inputs, "out" for outputs. Leave it empty for both.

midi.ports.returns: in and/or out: each a list of port names.

midi.devices.description: Lists the MIDI In and MIDI Out connections you set up on the MIDI page.
midi.devices.returns: in and out: each a list of connections with id, name, device, state, open, present (plugged in), message and settings. MIDI In ones also list their events.

midi.open.description: Opens one of your MIDI connections so it can send or receive. Fails with an error when no connection has that name.

parameters.device: The connection's name from the MIDI page, like "Launchpad". Empty means the first one.
parameters.direction: Optional. "in" for a MIDI In connection, "out" for MIDI Out. Default "out".

midi.open.returns: true when the connection is open now, false when it could not be opened.

midi.close.description: Closes one of your MIDI connections. Fails with an error when no connection has that name.

parameters.device: The connection's name from the MIDI page, like "Launchpad". Empty means the first one.
parameters.direction: Optional. "in" for a MIDI In connection, "out" for MIDI Out. Default "out".

midi.sendNoteOn.description: Sends a note (like pressing a piano key) to a MIDI Out connection. It opens the connection if needed. Can also let go of the note after a while.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.channel: Optional. The MIDI channel, 1-16. Empty or "all" sends on all 16. Default 1.
parameters.note: Optional. The note: a number 0-127 (60 is middle C) or a name like "C4". Default 60.
parameters.velocity: Optional. How hard the key is pressed, 0-127. Default 127.
parameters.duration: Optional. With noteOff: how long to hold the note, in milliseconds, before letting go. Default 0.
parameters.noteOff: Optional. true also sends Note Off (lets go) after the duration. Your script waits for it. Default false.

midi.sendNoteOff.description: Sends Note Off (letting go of a key) to a MIDI Out connection.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.channel: Optional. The MIDI channel, 1-16. Empty or "all" sends on all 16. Default 1.
parameters.note: Optional. The note: a number 0-127 or a name like "C4". Default 60.
parameters.velocity: Optional. How fast the key is let go, 0-127. Default 0.

midi.sendControlChange.description: Sends a Control Change to a MIDI Out connection, like turning a knob or moving a slider.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.channel: Optional. The MIDI channel, 1-16. Empty or "all" sends on all 16. Default 1.
parameters.controller: Optional. Which knob or slider (controller number), 0-127. Default 0.

midi.sendEvent.description: Sends any channel message to a MIDI Out connection. Pick the kind of message and its two numbers.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.command: The kind of message: NoteOn, NoteOff, ControlChange, PatchChange, ChannelAfterTouch, PitchWheelChange or KeyAfterTouch.
parameters.channel: Optional. The MIDI channel, 1-16. Empty or "all" sends on all 16. Default 1.
parameters.data1: Optional. The first number, 0-127 (like the note or controller). For PitchWheelChange without data2: the whole value 0-16383. Default 0.
parameters.data2: Optional. The second number, 0-127 (like velocity or value). PatchChange and ChannelAfterTouch ignore it.

midi.sendSysex.description: Sends a SysEx message (a device-specific message) to a MIDI Out connection. F0 at the start and F7 at the end are added when missing.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.data: The message as hex bytes, like "F0 7E 7F 06 01 F7".

midi.sendRaw.description: Sends one complete MIDI message, written as hex bytes, to a MIDI Out connection. For advanced users.

parameters.device: The MIDI Out connection's name from the MIDI page. Empty means the first one.
parameters.data: The message as hex bytes, like "B0 07 64" (Control Change 7 to 100 on channel 1).
